# Move ThemeSwitcher checkmark CSS into the menu stylesheet

Please comment to claim before starting and check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

The theme switcher has a button class and a separate menu class. The review of #21716 called out a small CSS follow-up to match that split. [Review](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21716#pullrequestreview-6003111151)

## The Problem

The rules that draw and reveal the active theme's radio checkmark live in the button stylesheet. [Current stylesheet](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/resources/css/src/button/ThemeSwitcher.css)

## The Architectural Reality

The theme build maps source stylesheet paths to Neo class names. `Neo.menu.ThemeSwitcher` owns the radio rows and has a matching stylesheet path at `resources/css/src/menu/ThemeSwitcher.css`. [Menu class](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/menu/ThemeSwitcher.mjs)

## The Fix

Move the two `.neo-theme-switcher-menu [role="menuitemradio"]` pseudo-element rules, including the `aria-checked="true"` variant, into `resources/css/src/menu/ThemeSwitcher.css` with their declarations intact. Keep the button glyph and responsive label rules in the button stylesheet.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The two checkmark rules live in the menu stylesheet and the generated theme map includes `Neo.menu.ThemeSwitcher`.
- [ ] Open the theme picker, pick a different theme, and reopen it. The checkmark follows the active theme, the other rows preserve their alignment, and the button glyph and responsive label render as before.
- [ ] The existing ThemeSwitcher component tests pass.

## Out of Scope

Visual redesign, JavaScript changes, and rollout to additional examples.
